findings.title: Conditional delete outcome requires affected-row handling
findings.description: The source predicate requires both ID and COMPANY_STATE, but schema, transaction, and caller treatment of zero affected rows are unverified because metadata calls were rejected.
findings.recommendation: Treat a zero affected-row result explicitly and map a state mismatch to the intended business or concurrency outcome.

findings.title: Predicate index support is unverified
findings.description: The mapper filters by ID and COMPANY_STATE, while COMPANY columns and indexes could not be retrieved.
findings.recommendation: Use approved schema metadata to verify the intended uniqueness and index support for the predicate.
